column_description: TEXT. Primary key uniquely identifying each transplant matching record. PK = Transplant_Matching(Match_Rec_Registry). Example: TM113504.
TIMESTAMP. Timestamp when matching record was created. Example: 2025-02-19 08:31:22.330375.
TEXT. Reference to donor demographics record. FK to Demographics.
TEXT. Reference to recipient demographics record. FK to Recipients_Demographics.
TEXT. Specific organs type being matched for transplant. Possible values: Heart, Kidney, Liver, Lung, Pancreas.
TEXT. Current status of the matching process. Possible values: Completed, Failed, In Progress, Matched, Pending.
REAL. Overall matching score for donor-recipient compatibility. Example: 0.005.
TEXT. Matching level classification. Possible values: Acceptable, High Risk, Marginal, Optimal.
TEXT. Version of matching algorithm used. Example: v2.5.
TEXT. Matching run identifier for batch processing. Example: MR324767.
TIMESTAMP. Timestamp when matching algorithm was executed. ** Possible values: 2025.02.19 08:31:22.
BIGINT. Duration of matching process in seconds. Example: 128.
REAL. Confidence value for matching result. Example: 0.056.
REAL. Decision support system score. Example: 0.68.
